top.line: What Synergy Six Degrees rates with OCRR, recovers with NeuShield and protects with Actifile, and the agent rows my work adds.
top.para: A London analyst firm built OCRR, a consultant-delivered rating of resilience across operational, data, financial and people disciplines, starting free from industry defaults, and distributes NeuShield, which keeps original files intact, and Actifile, which finds, encrypts and prices sensitive data. The intersection is agents: a rating needs rows for what each is for, what contains it and what it costs, which behaviour policies, SHarness and sgit supply.

in-short.line: An analyst firm with a new resilience rating and two products; the missing rows are agents.
in-short.para: OCRR rates four disciplines, starts free, deploys nothing and uses no AI; RiskMandate, SHarness and sgit add the mandate, the containment and recoverable data.

what.line: Synergy Six Degrees: analyst research, go-to-market consultancy, and distribution of NeuShield and Actifile.
what.para: A specialist analyst firm in cyber security and data protection, based in London, now with an assessment of its own.

ocrr.line: OCRR rates operational, data, financial and people resilience in one executive conversation.
ocrr.para: Overall and discipline ratings, financial context and priorities. Three stages: a free five-page summary from industry defaults in two days; a guided assessment of about 500 fields in under two hours of client time; and an appraisal of proposed changes. Consultant-delivered, nothing to deploy, no AI.

products.line: NeuShield keeps the original file so ransomware damage can be reverted; Actifile finds, encrypts and prices data.
products.para: NeuShield, from Fremont, describes Mirror Shielding as a layer that leaves the original intact; Actifile, from Herzliya per directories, puts a money figure on exposure. Both are vendor descriptions.

intersection.line: Agents are part of the workforce now, and a resilience rating needs rows for them.
intersection.para: Behaviour policies give each agent's purpose, reach and barriers; agents add run cost and risk cost; SHarness contains an agent's processes in the kernel; sgit keeps data immutable, encrypted and recoverable; and the assessment itself could travel as a vault.

layers.line: Five questions: rate, mandate, contain, recover, protect, and no piece answers all five.
layers.para: OCRR rates; RiskMandate mandates; SHarness contains; NeuShield and sgit recover; Actifile and sgit protect. Agents as an option in OCRR's elevated stage is a proposal.

limits.line: No published scale, vendor claims untested, the mapping is a reading, the site is mid-redesign.
limits.para: SHarness's whole-agent launcher is still a design.

sources.line: The firm's own pages, NeuShield's 2018 announcement, and this site's articles on policies, costs, insurance, SHarness and vaults.
